conclusion.rootCauseOfZero: Not a decode bug. ContractResultV1.weight_required is Weight{ref_time: Compact<u64>, proof_size: Compact<u64>}; the polkadot.js metadata decode and an independent hand decode of the raw SCALE bytes agree (proof_size compact byte 0x00). On V3 spec 3002 Revive's contract-execution meter does not charge proof_size: weight_required.proof_size is 0 with gas_limit None, at the block max_extrinsic, and with an explicit proof_size LIMIT of 0 the instantiate still succeeds (only ref_time triggers OutOfGas, Module 80 error 0x03). System BlockWeights has max_block.proof_size = u64::MAX (standalone chain, PoV not bounded). The old escrow-*-dryrun 0s are therefore real readings, not a bug; those files are unchanged.
conclusion.measuredProofSize: The only non-zero, measured proof_size is the extrinsic-level static weight of revive.instantiate_with_code: TransactionPaymentCallApi_query_call_info gives pre-dispatch proof_size = weight_limit.proof_size + 6,823 (today, both variants). On chain, deploy at #102843 ext 1 (checkpoint #102840) was charged ExtrinsicSuccess weight {ref_time 1,524,333,644, proof_size 19,007} with a 1,000,000 proof limit, i.e. the whole execution proof limit was refunded and only the static part was charged.
conclusion.recommendedDeployLimit: weight_limit = { ref_time: weight_required.ref_time * 1.2 (dry run), proof_size: a stated non-zero cap, e.g. 1,000,000 as in #102840 (refunded; costs ~0.0003 tPOT extra pre-dispatch fee) }, and check the whole extrinsic with query_call_info: pre-dispatch proof_size must equal cap + measured static overhead. Do NOT relax Sentinel's rule to accept 0 from weight_required; the dry run's 0 means 'not metered', which still is not a measured bound.
